title: Soul Eater — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. Soul Eater (Japanese: ソウルイーター, Hepburn: Sōru Ītā) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Atsushi Ohkubo. Set at the "Death Weapon Meister Academy", the series revolves around three teams, each consisting of a weapon meister and at least one human that can transform into a weapon.

The nihilist does not deny Soul Eater — he only refuses to flatter it. It later aired on Adult Swim's Toonami programming block from February 17, 2013, to March 16, 2014. Six pieces of theme music are used for the episodes: two opening themes and four ending themes.
